protocol: 60 min constant-load cycling at 40% VO2peak then four Wingate sets with 30 min constant load between; water (W), 8% glucose (G) or trehalose (T) drink after set 1; blood glucose, lactate, insulin, FFA, catecholamines
note: Time courses are in figures; text quotes glucose at some points and Table 3 the catecholamine AUC; water trial is the control.
